data.name: 10ⁿ - Ten Power N
data.detailed_description:
Explore Every Scale

Ten Power N is a Science & Fiction strategy-simulation that takes you from the quantum foam to cosmic mega structures. Each level introduces new challenges, blending exploration, learning, and strategy in a seamless journey through scales of the universe.

Build, Manage, Adapt

Combine base building, resource management, and tower defense while engaging with AI-driven factions. The game rewards strategic thinking and adaptability, offering a rich experience for players who enjoy planning, cooperation, and discovery.

Define Your Path

Whether you focus on scientific advancement, cooperation, fight, or innovation, your actions determine the fate of your civilization. The game is designed to inspire curiosity, offering a rich, evolving universe where every playthrough tells a unique story.

A Universe to Discover

Designed for fans of civilization-building, science fiction, and curious minds, Ten Power N challenges you to explore, learn, and strategize across the universe. The heat death of the universe is coming. How will you respond?

data.short_description: 10ⁿ - TEN POWER N is a science & fiction strategy-simulation where you create, explore and conquer the universe from quantum foam to the cosmic expanse. Traverse 19 levels, manage more than 600 resources, defend your simulation. The universe isn’t just yours to explore – it’s yours to command!
